bio.text: Michael LiPetri Jr., a Republican, is a former New York State Assembly member who represented the 9th Assembly District.
He lost the 2024 race for New York's 3rd Congressional District to Democratic Rep. Tom Suozzi, 48.1% to 51.7%, according to state election data cited by PoliticsNY.
He announced a 2026 rematch bid on February 3, 2026, and won the Republican primary in June 2026 over Greg Hach.

sources.title: Suozzi, LiPetri win congressional primaries, set up rematch in November
